steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this what you meant by... "collaborative effort"?
The Bureau's VIP lounge has been decorated in an Eastern style, with wisps of smoke curling through the air.
Du Ruo leans back on the soft couch, looking as comfortable as if she were at home, flipping through a report in her hands.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Your subordinates are diligent. I merely mentioned that Chief agreed to provide me with a comfortably furnished room, and look how nicely they've spruced up the place.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The directive from above is for the MBCC to seek a method to eliminate the Sun Crow at your guidance. You said we'd have many things to discuss. Such as?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Eastia has practical experience in dealing with the Sun Crow but lacks theoretical conclusions. The research here is the perfect supplement for reference. I'm trying to cram down as much knowledge as I can.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: As for discovering unusual phenomena and crafting the Almighty Bow, Yanyan is more reliable than I am. She will show you the way.
She glances at your displeased expression and laughs. She covers her mouth with her hand and coughs softly, in spite of her complexion all rosy and healthy.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Excuse me. I have been buried in books for years and neglected my physical health. It's already a stretch for me to have traveled here, not to mention the adjustment to the new environment and exposure to the sun...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I'd only be a burden if I insisted on going with you... So, with a heavy heart, I'm entrusting the exciting task of crafting the Almighty Bow to you and Yanyan.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: If you encounter any interesting incidents or rumors along the way, do share them with me so I can study them further. Let me contribute to the great cause of bow-making in my own way. Best of luck, see you!
Then she lies back down, switching to a more comfortable position.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh, want to hang out a bit more? Then why not tell me about your nightmare? I can give you an analysis now. Maybe I'll discover something new.
She suggests with a teasing smile. But for the first time, the scholar closes the book in her hands and looks you straight in the eyes...
Those eyes are much more honest than their owner, glinting with a solid desire. Since the first meeting, she's seemed very interested in your dreams.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll tell you what I dreamed about, and you'll tell me the truth about those sun-shooting myths.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The "cultural differences between the two cities" are a vague excuse, I don't buy it. I'll feel like you're hiding something if you don't spell everything out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You wouldn't want any rifts in this cooperation, right, Miss Ambassador?
Du Ruo narrows her eyes as she looks you up and down, then begins slowly.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It's normal to have reservations. I'm not bothered by your suspicions toward me, Chief. If one day you find that you can truly trust me, I will tell you all my stories.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: But with the disaster looming now, try not to overcomplicate things.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then let's talk about that dream when you tire of these mind games.
You hold each other's gaze and simply wait for the other person to answer first. Suddenly, the door opens and a girl stumbles in.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Du Ruo, Du Ruo! Yanyan had another psychic dream! I dreamed there were ten suns in the sky and plenty of demons and monsters in the fire! One of them was a giant bird with human eyes and wearing a mask. It held my head in its beak and tried to eat me!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: That must be the Sun Crow! But in the dream, a hero came and shot it down with an arrow! Du Ruo, you're the best at interpreting dreams. Can you tell if this is a good omen?
Yanyan gestures around the lounge dramatically. Though her description is all over the place, you realize... her dream is exactly the same as yours?
The dream interpreter simply props her chin on her hands languidly, observing your reaction.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh, did you have the same dream, Chief? Yanyan is the chosen seer who receives oracles through her psychic dreams. How do you explain your dream then?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh my, you two aren't long-lost siblings, are you?
steps.female_content: Oh my, you two aren't long-lost sisters, are you?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Did you also dream of the same big bird, Chief? Cool! It must be a good omen then, because we're setting off to craft the Almighty Bow together today!
Yanyan has already jumped up to grab your arm. Her palms are abnormally hot, reminding you of the fiery bird in your dream. You pat the girl's head and turn to Du Ruo.

options: Do you have anything else to tell me?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: A scholar is neither omniscient nor omnipotent. I'm always on the path of seeking the truth... Let's talk again when you return. You and Yanyan will get along well.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: After all, you had the same dream. Maybe it really is a good omen.

Her expression has already changed and she's stashed away her curiosity about you. Du Ruo picks up the documents and lies sideways on the couch, seeming concentrated on her reading and reluctant to be disturbed.

Black Rings, Corruptors, the DisSea... Even DisCity doesn't have a definitive explanation for everything. They hypothesize that the Apostles of Ashes originate from the highly concentrated collective human subconsciousness. They are projections from the psychic dimension into the material world. This aligns with the notion of "divine and demonic entities". As the collective subconscious is erratic and unstable, so are the manifestations of the Apostles of Ashes. It can be inferred that during the era of disasters, the Apostles that are most likely to survive this unusual selection process are those that induce the most fear, despair, and negative impressions.

According to seers' psychic records, besides attacking humans, calamitous demons, aka Apostles of Ashes, also engage in mutual predation. It now seems this is not for power but to eliminate competitors and ensure their own survival. Their desire to enter the DisSea may possibly stem from the same reason. The Ring Research Institute considers this an instinct of the Apostles and uses this affinity for the DisSea as a criterion to distinguish this "species" from ordinary Corruptors. Moreover, this tendency is specific to BR-000 and not other Black Rings. Near DisCity, this instinct even overrides all their other characteristics.
